description: Major South African highway binary crack dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Hermann Tapamo, Anna Bosman (University of Pretoria). Binary crack dataset prepared using flexible road pavement images from a major South African Highway.The dataset has been used in the publication titled: Convolutional Neural Networks for Crack Detection on Flexible Road Pavements which was presented at the 14th International Conference on Soft Computing and Pattern Recognition (SoCPaR 2022) and forms part of the conference ... Coverage: a major South African highway. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
